Launder them through your contacts
Reach $250,000 in laundering earnings
Verify Dime on the Dollar is earned

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a combined $100,000 across shops for Treat Yo Self. Keep track of shop purchases and prioritize things you already want so the spending target fits naturally into your playthrough. Review the running total between shopping sessions before making the remaining purchases. Once shop spending reaches $100,000, confirm the earned trophy in your PlayStation list.
trophies.steps:
Review your shop spending total
Make purchases across shops
Bring combined spending to $100,000
Check Treat Yo Self has unlocked

Check ownership and purchase costs
Purchase every remaining garage
Verify Little Boxes has unlocked
